9b2897133ed2fe5b.what: Measured cross-plane thermal conductivity of (001) κ-Ga2O3 thin films on sapphire by FDTR: 1.83 to 2.26 W/m·K for 159 to 689 nm thickness.
9b2897133ed2fe5b.why: To understand thermal limits and self-heating of κ-Ga2O3 electronics, whose thermal conductivity is lower than other Ga2O3 polymorphs.
9b2897133ed2fe5b.how: Frequency-domain thermoreflectance (293 to 400 K) combined with first-principles calculations including phonon-phonon and phonon-boundary scattering.
9b2897133ed2fe5b.impact: Relevant to the GaN/AlGaN HEMT and GaN/Al2O3 interface projects: a template for size-dependent κ with first-principles BTE and an FDTR benchmark for wide-bandgap films (McGaughey group, a watched author). Moderate relevance.

1386de5395695b1c.what: Introduces IANN, an open-source PyTorch framework reimplementing PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2/V3 and UMA behind one data object, trainer and deployment route; also releases PaiNN foundation models trained on 41.9 million DFT structures.
1386de5395695b1c.why: Software fragmentation makes comparing MLIP architectures or moving a trained model into production simulations require heavy re-engineering.
1386de5395695b1c.how: Forces and stresses come from one analytic differentiation w.r.t. edge vectors; automatic distributed training under SLURM/PBS/MPI; checkpoints work as ASE calculators, ensembles, or TorchScript models in LAMMPS via C++ pair styles with multi-GPU inference.
1386de5395695b1c.impact: Useful for the InGaAs (DeePMD vs MACE) and AlGaN MLIP pipelines and MLPhonon: one framework to compare architectures on the same data and deploy into LAMMPS. Worth testing.

3b191f253bcce474.what: Interpretable ML framework screens over 52,000 3D covalent organic frameworks and identifies 26 with κ above 0.8 W/m·K and Young's modulus below 8 GPa.
3b191f253bcce474.why: High thermal conductivity and low stiffness are normally mutually exclusive in thermal management materials.
3b191f253bcce474.how: Molecular simulations, six benchmarked ML models (random forest best), SHAP feature analysis and phonon-level transport analysis.
3b191f253bcce474.impact: Low relevance to the listed projects (organic frameworks), but the SHAP-plus-phonon-analysis workflow is a transferable idea for interpretable ML on κ.

e5833a9b4f7e745b.what: Identifies local topology hallucination in universal MLIPs: distinct model minima relax into the same DFT basin, due to curvature-sign errors shared by MACE, CHGNet and M3GNet.
e5833a9b4f7e745b.why: Predicting metastable states needs MLIPs to preserve the minima and saddles of the reference potential-energy surface.
e5833a9b4f7e745b.how: Curvature signs from two of three models agreed with DFT in 55 of 57 positive but only 5 of 56 negative cases; a directional two-displacement DFT test rejected 9 of 12 predicted instabilities.
e5833a9b4f7e745b.impact: Directly relevant to MLIP failure modes in the MACE-based InGaAs/AlGaN/BAs work: spurious soft or unstable modes would corrupt lattice dynamics and phonon calculations in MLPhonon. Worth reading and adding a DFT check on imaginary modes.

a77c3f56a26fb996.what: Fabricated suspended bilayer graphene thermal bridges (1 to 30 μm) and measured length-independent κ of about 570 W/m·K at room temperature; HNEMD shows about 0.01 monolayer of amorphous carbon suppresses ZA phonons.
a77c3f56a26fb996.why: The intrinsic thermal conductivity of graphene remains controversial; the work seeks a lower bound under realistic contamination.
a77c3f56a26fb996.how: A patterning and transfer technique for thermal-bridge devices, measured from 250 to 350 K, plus homogeneous non-equilibrium MD simulations.
a77c3f56a26fb996.impact: Related to interfacial and surface scattering of phonons (GaN/Al2O3 interfaces, grain boundaries); the ZA-suppression argument is a mechanism analogy. Low to moderate relevance.

bdb476bd5b7d1657.what: A classical-to-DFT multi-fidelity workflow for generating MLIP training data, in which long classical MD trajectories are supplemented with selectively DFT-optimized configurations.
bdb476bd5b7d1657.why: MLIP reliability depends on the quality and diversity of the training data, which is costly to produce with DFT.
bdb476bd5b7d1657.how: Tested on bulk water, the air-water interface, and CaSO4 in bulk water and at the interface; also tests extrapolation to other temperatures, pressures and interfacial geometries.
bdb476bd5b7d1657.impact: The data-efficiency idea (cheap classical sampling plus targeted DFT) could transfer to the AlGaN or BAs active-learning pipelines, but the systems are aqueous. Low to moderate relevance.

84428a6a2ff3f753.what: Presents a p-GaN gate HEMT with a grounded Schottky contact (GSC-HEMT) that achieves a single-event burnout voltage above 500 V under Ta ion irradiation (82.06 MeV cm2/mg).
84428a6a2ff3f753.why: Irradiation-induced holes accumulate beneath the gate in conventional p-GaN HEMTs, raising the local field and gate leakage.
84428a6a2ff3f753.how: A source-connected Schottky contact on the barrier layer between gate and drain collects the holes.
84428a6a2ff3f753.impact: Low relevance to the thermal-modeling projects (a radiation-hardness paper, not thermal), though it is context on GaN HEMT device trends.

deaafe4c0208b98d.what: Reports a nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the optical band gap of layered TiNCl, with a minimum near 50 K.
deaafe4c0208b98d.why: It contrasts with the monotonic decrease typical of conventional semiconductors.
deaafe4c0208b98d.how: Temperature-dependent PL, diffuse reflectance and XRD, a Bose-Einstein oscillator fit (phonon energies about 8.9 and 1.2 meV) and first-principles phonon calculations.
deaafe4c0208b98d.impact: Low relevance; electron-phonon physics in a different material, only loosely related to phonon calculations with phonopy.

0269ab7465077bda.what: Evaluates pretrained MACE-based foundation models on Na/C motifs in hard carbon and fine-tunes them to recover a DFT-level description.
0269ab7465077bda.why: Reliability of foundation models across competing bonding regimes is unclear; relevant for Na-ion batteries.
0269ab7465077bda.how: The pretrained models fail for Na-Na and Na-C interactions in metallic Na clusters on graphene; targeted fine-tuning gives transferability to unseen Na/C environments and links closed-pore radius to plateau voltage.
0269ab7465077bda.impact: Relevant as a case of foundation-model failure and fine-tuning with MACE, informing the MACE vs Deep Potential comparison for InGaAs. Moderate relevance; application domain is batteries.

4d2527396ccaf997.what: Ultrafast stroboSCAT imaging of heat, charge and exciton transport in black phosphorus: armchair:zigzag anisotropy rises from 5.3:1 in bulk to 6.7:1 in the monolayer.
4d2527396ccaf997.why: To resolve directional energy transport in an anisotropic low-dimensional semiconductor.
4d2527396ccaf997.how: Picosecond-resolution optical scattering microscopy plus first-principles calculations attributing the result to exciton-phonon scattering to large momenta along the zigzag direction.
4d2527396ccaf997.impact: Low relevance to the listed projects; anisotropy of transport is conceptually related to phonon direction asymmetry in BaTiO3.

b92d50e803998f78.what: Investigates single-event burnout in p-GaN gate HEMTs through Ta ion irradiation (67 MeV cm2/mg) and simulation, finding two failure modes and the drain edge as the most sensitive region.
b92d50e803998f78.why: To explain the SEB mechanism in GaN power devices.
b92d50e803998f78.how: Irradiation experiments, damage comparison, and simulated transient currents and temperature distributions; hole accumulation at GaN/AlN and electron accumulation at Si/AlN interfaces enhance impact ionization and lead to thermal runaway at the drain.
b92d50e803998f78.impact: Some relevance to the GaN HEMT project, since lattice temperature rise and thermal runaway at the drain are device self-heating effects, although this is a radiation study. Low to moderate.

6aa19340b7ff780d.what: A persistent socket interface connects the GMIN, OPTIM and PATHSAMPLE energy-landscape tools to ASE-compatible potentials, applied to Ga vacancies in β-Ga2O3 with two NequIP-based potentials.
6aa19340b7ff780d.why: Energy landscape exploration needs many energy and force evaluations, so efficient access to MLIPs is a practical challenge.
6aa19340b7ff780d.how: The calculator and socket stay active through the search; kinetic transition networks, mean first-passage times and heat capacities describe vacancy migration.
6aa19340b7ff780d.impact: Low relevance; a defect-kinetics method for Ga2O3, though it shows an ASE-to-MLIP workflow pattern.

d121a64c7ee90b9f.what: Builds interpretable bonding and charge-transfer descriptors from COGITO, which maps plane-wave DFT onto a minimal basis of adaptive atomic orbitals.
d121a64c7ee90b9f.why: Converting periodic electronic structure into interpretable, transferable descriptors remains challenging.
d121a64c7ee90b9f.how: Reduces the high-dimensional COGITO bonding information into descriptors of covalent bonding and charge transfer and decomposes band dispersion into range-resolved parts (silicon conduction band minimum as example).
d121a64c7ee90b9f.impact: Low relevance; possible use as interpretable features for MLIP latent-space or bonding analysis, but no thermal transport content.

d10f96a008b40029.what: Validates feature attribution in a physics-aware GNN ensemble, deliberately overfit on CoMoFeNiCu decomposition enthalpies, using atomic-swap perturbations.
d10f96a008b40029.why: It is unclear whether GNN feature importance reflects physical reality or statistical artifacts.
d10f96a008b40029.how: About 900 binary and 4,500 ternary DFT decomposition pathways; perturbing single sites shows spatial decay consistent with the GNN interaction cutoff.
d10f96a008b40029.impact: Relevant to the interest in MLIP and GNN interpretability, with a perturbation-based test that could be adapted to MLIPs. Moderate relevance; different material system.

a9981c9eeed2d3af.what: Develops a temperature-dependent screw dislocation mobility law and a unified constitutive model for BCC metals from discrete dislocation dynamics.
a9981c9eeed2d3af.why: Predicting plastic flow across temperature and strain rates requires separating structural resistance from kinetic contributions.
a9981c9eeed2d3af.how: Discrete dislocation dynamics tension and compression simulations at different dislocation densities; identifies the crossover where phonon drag overtakes thermal activation.
a9981c9eeed2d3af.impact: Low relevance; dislocation mechanics, with only a loose link to the dislocation-core phonon work (BaTiO3, GaN).

83228f813ed8e206.what: A GUI and Python script generator for calculations with universal MLIPs (MACE, UMA, Orb, SevenNet, MatterSim, GRACE, DPA).
83228f813ed8e206.how: Supports phonons, elastic constants, MD, NEB and geometry optimization through a Streamlit interface.
83228f813ed8e206.impact: Could speed up quick phonon checks and cross-model comparisons of universal MLIPs; relevant to MLPhonon-style workflows. Moderate relevance.

0f8c106d8cec65ac.what: An explainer of acoustic micro imaging (AMI), a high-frequency ultrasound inspection method for advanced packaging.
0f8c106d8cec65ac.why: Defects such as delaminations and air gaps cause electrical or mechanical failures and hurt yield and reliability as features shrink.
0f8c106d8cec65ac.how: A transducer sends ultrasound pulses, scanned across the sample; software analysis of the images supports accept or reject decisions.
0f8c106d8cec65ac.impact: Low relevance; packaging inspection, though delamination and thermal interface defects matter for thermal management industry context.

a685520c7bd53fba.what: GPUMD, a GPU-accelerated molecular dynamics code (CUDA) with machine-learning potentials, a repository entry.
a685520c7bd53fba.how: CUDA MD code; topics list heat transport, phonon, neuroevolution potentials and high-performance computing.
a685520c7bd53fba.impact: Relevant to the HPC and GPU-accelerated phonon work and to thermal MD with MLIPs (alongside LAMMPS); worth tracking as an NEP/HNEMD tool. Moderate to high relevance.

98fef8f4637d26b7.what: ASU and Ampere Computing published DT-MATCH, a defect- and topology-aware chiplet matching framework to maximize functional SoCs.
98fef8f4637d26b7.why: Heterogeneous integration brings yield challenges from manufacturing defects and die-to-die interconnect constraints.
98fef8f4637d26b7.how: An ILP-based approach with batching and a faster GRASP-based approach, with preprocessing; tested on industrial designs.
98fef8f4637d26b7.impact: Low relevance; yield optimization, not thermal, though it is industry context on chiplet packaging.

b93ebb3696544e9a.what: A weekly industry roundup covering Infineon's 300mm SiC power-device milestone, imec's silicon-interposer platform, new AMD, Arm and Google chips, and export-control news.
b93ebb3696544e9a.how: News digest from SEMICON Europa and electronica 2026.
b93ebb3696544e9a.impact: Low relevance; background on advanced packaging, SiC power devices and AI hardware that drive thermal management demand.

8cfb01aa7e1f9c4e.what: DynaPhoPy, a code for phonon anharmonicity analysis from molecular dynamics.
8cfb01aa7e1f9c4e.how: Works with LAMMPS and VASP MD output and phonopy; a repository entry.
8cfb01aa7e1f9c4e.impact: Relevant to extracting temperature-dependent phonon properties from MLIP MD (InGaAs, BAs) and comparing with lattice dynamics. Moderate to high relevance.

0ae0b9d9fad1a487.what: SciLink, a repository of LLM-powered agents for scientific research automation.
0ae0b9d9fad1a487.how: Agentic framework; topics list DFT, molecular dynamics, microscopy and spectroscopy.
0ae0b9d9fad1a487.impact: Relevant to the interest in agents and automated workflows for first-principles and thermal-MD calculations; worth inspecting its design. Moderate relevance.

9504a65528084695.what: LAMMPS stable release update 1 (30 Sep 2026 stable), a bug-fix release.
9504a65528084695.why: Backports bug fixes from the development version.
9504a65528084695.how: Includes fixes to fix gcmc, fix press/langevin, OPENMP, the Python module, QEq for ReaxFF memory spikes, plus LAMMPS-GUI v3.1.2.
9504a65528084695.impact: Low to moderate relevance; no listed fix touches MLIP or heat-flux features, but LAMMPS is a core tool, so consider updating.

94a0e239e597d109.what: fairchem-core 2.26.0 release: a UMA inference regression suite, lazy imports, preserved autograd graphs for UMA Hessian inference and training, and several bug fixes.
94a0e239e597d109.how: Release notes listing enhancements, bug fixes (e.g. left-handed cells in the neighbor list, detached conservative energy outputs) and tests.
94a0e239e597d109.impact: Moderate relevance if UMA is used for phonons: Hessian inference support could matter for lattice dynamics.

aae7f20b490c0cbd.what: ALAMODE 2.0.2, a packaging release with binary wheels of the alm and anphon Python modules on PyPI (alamode-python).
aae7f20b490c0cbd.why: To make installation easier; calculations are unchanged.
aae7f20b490c0cbd.how: Wheels for Linux (x86_64, aarch64) and macOS arm64; Python 3.11 or newer and Boost 1.67 or newer required.
aae7f20b490c0cbd.impact: Relevant, since ALAMODE is in the tool list: pip install simplifies setup; note the package rename (uninstall alamode first if installed from source).

8821f37128221161.what: npj Computational Materials collection on machine learning interatomic potentials: architectures, data generation, sampling and applications.
8821f37128221161.why: MLIPs are essential for long-time-scale simulations at high accuracy.
8821f37128221161.how: Submission status Closed; deadline was 14 December 2025.
8821f37128221161.impact: Closed, so cannot be submitted to; topics (interpretability, data efficiency, robustness) match the MLIP work, so use it as a venue reference.

8a0f8219854c0db9.what: npj Computational Materials collection on transport mechanisms in energy materials (thermal transport in thermoelectrics, ion and charge transport), combining computation, AI and in-situ characterization.
8a0f8219854c0db9.why: Transport of electrons and ions limits energy conversion and storage efficiency.
8a0f8219854c0db9.how: Submission status Closed; deadline was 31 October 2024.
8a0f8219854c0db9.impact: Closed, not submittable; topically fits phonon transport work, useful as a venue signal only.

bab05c2e3264666f.what: npj Computational Materials collection on Materials-AI bidirectional innovation: AI for materials discovery and autonomous platforms, and materials for AI hardware.
bab05c2e3264666f.why: AI and materials science are increasingly bidirectional.
bab05c2e3264666f.impact: Open until July 2027. Would fit an agents or automated-workflow paper for first-principles and lattice-dynamics calculations; worth considering.

d21400bdc0b1a487.what: Cross-journal collection on altermagnetic materials across Nature Communications, Communications Materials and Scientific Reports.
d21400bdc0b1a487.why: Altermagnets combine zero net magnetization with strong spin polarization, giving unconventional magneto-responses.
d21400bdc0b1a487.impact: Low relevance; no project involves altermagnetism.

afb75b7223404ee3.what: First-principles study of cubic CsPbBr3 (above 403 K): electronic, optical, lattice dynamics and thermoelectric properties; ZT reaches 0.39 at 800 K. Conference poster for eNergetics 2026 (virtual, 23 to 24 Nov 2026).
afb75b7223404ee3.why: Most measurements are on the orthorhombic phase, while the lattice dynamics and transport of the cubic phase are not established.
afb75b7223404ee3.how: VASP with PBE and HSE06 plus SOC, phonopy finite displacements in a 2x2x2 supercell, BoltzTraP2 with a relaxation time from Fröhlich polaron theory; lattice κ at the Cahill-Pohl minimum of 0.475 W/m·K.
afb75b7223404ee3.impact: Low relevance; uses the same VASP and phonopy tools but with a standard harmonic workflow on a halide perovskite.

5db34865d4de927d.what: Heatless, room-temperature metal bonding for micro-transfer printed GaN HEMTs using undercooled liquid metallic core-shell Field's metal particles.
5db34865d4de927d.why: Polymer adhesives in micro-transfer printing create a thermal bottleneck due to low thermal conductivity.
5db34865d4de927d.how: GaN/AlGaN coupons from Qromis wafers printed onto silicon; shear speed and distance optimized; a dual-stage process adds a rigid glass stamping step to get a dense metallic layer.
5db34865d4de927d.impact: Relevant to the GaN/AlGaN HEMT project as industry context on thermal interfaces in heterogeneous GaN integration; the interface layer is a candidate boundary resistance in device-scale models. Moderate relevance.

44350785420834cb.what: Cu3Sb0.98Sn0.02Se4 with PbSe composites reaching peak zT of 0.77 at 623 K and power factor of 999.35 μW/m·K2.
44350785420834cb.why: Sn doping optimizes thermoelectric properties but harms thermal properties of Cu3SbSe4.
44350785420834cb.how: Microwave-hydrothermal synthesis with spark plasma sintering; heterointerfaces, point defects and grain boundaries scatter phonons; first-principles calculations of bands and phonon dispersion.
44350785420834cb.impact: Low relevance; experimental thermoelectric synthesis, with only loose links to interface phonon scattering.

ea6c404c6ec9cb21.what: DFT study of the structural, elastic, electronic, optical and thermal properties of YAl2Si2 and LaAl2Si2.
ea6c404c6ec9cb21.why: To evaluate the mechanical stability and potential thermoelectric, optoelectronic and UV-protection applications.
ea6c404c6ec9cb21.how: DFT with elastic constants, band structure with SOC, phonon dispersion and thermodynamic analysis.
ea6c404c6ec9cb21.impact: Low relevance; routine DFT property survey of materials outside the listed projects.

3041cb4f5b77bdb6.what: CuInSnSe4 made by atomic cross-substitution from CuInSe2: anionic lone-pair-like Se electrons cut room-temperature κL from 4.48 to 1.26 W/m·K; predicted ZT of 1.99 (p-type) and 0.79 (n-type).
3041cb4f5b77bdb6.why: Lone-pair strategies for lowering κL were thought limited to ns2 cations such as Sb3+ and Bi3+.
3041cb4f5b77bdb6.how: The anionic lone pairs weaken Se-Se interactions, flatten optical phonon branches and enlarge the scattering phase space.
3041cb4f5b77bdb6.impact: Moderate relevance for mechanism understanding: phase-space and anharmonicity arguments mirror the phonon analysis in lattice-dynamics workflows (ALAMODE, phono3py), though the material is a thermoelectric chalcogenide.

dec6d31e95cc7c71.what: ARaymond introduced a new generation of polymer Universal Quick Disconnects (UQDs) for data center liquid cooling.
dec6d31e95cc7c71.why: AI-driven high-density computing is increasing cooling needs and demands on scalability, coolant integrity and installation.
dec6d31e95cc7c71.impact: Low to moderate relevance; an electronics-cooling industry trend (liquid-cooled data centers) rather than a modeling topic.

883a17a10d27d03b.what: NVIDIA blog on accelerating molecular dynamics with cuPotential, offering accurate, flexible primitives for GPU MD.
883a17a10d27d03b.why: As GPUs evolve, optimizing kernels and ensuring compatibility across heterogeneous hardware has become harder.
883a17a10d27d03b.impact: Relevant to HPC and GPU-accelerated MD interests; worth a look for MLIP or LAMMPS performance, though details are not stated in the excerpt. Moderate relevance.
